headline: Blackwing Lair in 32:38, a guild best at the time, with one boss death

mvp.headline: the most damage on the last five bosses
why: First on Firemaw, Ebonroc, Flamegor, Chromaggus (118k) and Nefarian (134k), third on the first three

also.text: the most damage on Broodlord, second on Vaelastrasz, Firemaw and Chromaggus
26 afflictions cleansed on Chromaggus, the most, and a Rebirth on Osinir
the most damage on Razorgore and 7 interrupts, the most

overview: Eight kills in 32:38, then the guild's fastest Blackwing Lair (13 Nov has since done 28:29), against a usual 47:25. The one boss death was Firetoad to a Bone Construct at 1:26 on Nefarian.

After Razorgore died the log has a second 45-second Razorgore segment at full health with no deaths, almost all of its damage from Blackwing Technician bombs, so most likely trash the log tagged with the encounter rather than a real wipe.
Every Frenzy on Flamegor was tranquilized and 4 of 5 on Chromaggus. Warcraft Logs handed out no parses for this raid.

wentWell.text: Flamegor with all 4 Frenzies tranquilized and Fire Nova at about 60% of the usual rate.
Chromaggus with 88 afflictions cleansed (Elozia 26, Eînherjer 25, Allipalli 22) and every breath on the tank.

notes.text: 0:27 (median 0:46), no deaths. One Burning Adrenaline, on Birdiebird.
0:50 (median 1:40), no deaths, Flame Buffet stacks at about half the usual.
0:46, no deaths, 4 of 4 Frenzies tranquilized (Darkestnight 2, Speldosan 2, Birdiebird 1 shot).
1:20, no deaths. All six breath hits on Macharius, who was tanking. 4 of 5 Frenzies tranquilized.
1:31 (median 2:25). A Bone Construct killed Firetoad at 1:26, the only death. Gertggs 134k, Orbywan 131k.
